name: TryPost
description: Plan, schedule, and publish social posts across every connected network from your TryPost workspace.

methods.whenToUse: Use browser sign-in for the provider-hosted MCP server.
methods.guidanceMd: Sign in to TryPost and pick the workspace agents should publish from. Every tool acts inside that one workspace, and members who need approval get a pending_approval post instead of a live post.
methods.label: Sign in with TryPost
warnings: Publishing reaches the connected social networks, so review posts before any publish, approve, or delete tool runs.
This card always uses TryPost Cloud. A self-hosted TryPost deployment connects by pasting its own MCP URL.
